name: system-server-phase550-permissionpolicyservice-permissioncontroller-ce-mirror-inode-lookup
pinned_wall: Zygote CE mirror inode lookup failure (Unable to find <pkg>:<ce_data_inode> in /data_mirror/data_ce/null/0 at frameworks/base/core/jni/com_android_internal_os_Zygote.cpp:1126)

evidence.line_18536: PermissionPolicyService: Error granting/upgrading runtime permissions for user 0
evidence.line_18541: java.lang.RuntimeException: Failed to boot service com.android.server.policy.PermissionPolicyService: onBootPhase threw an exception during phase 550

supply_chain_analysis.expected_inode_origin: installd InstalldNativeService::createAppDataLocked queries get_path_inode() on /data/data/<pkg> (via create_data_user_ce_package_path) and returns it to PackageManagerService, which records it in PackageSetting (PackageUserState.ceDataInode). PMS passes it via Zygote socket argument --pkg-data-info-map to Zygote.
supply_chain_analysis.guest_inode_confirmation: uart.log:12499 and :13514 confirm path='/data/data/com.android.permissioncontroller' dev='tmpfs' ino=49935. The expected inode 49935 exactly matched the tmpfs inode created by installd during PMS first-boot package scan.
supply_chain_analysis.destruction_event: During PackageManagerService.systemReady(), UserManagerService.reconcileUsers() -> UserDataPreparer.reconcileUsers() executes enforceSerialNumber() which invokes Os.getxattr(path, 'user.serial'). On Linux 4.19 tmpfs, this returns ENOTSUP (errno 95). UserDataPreparer logs 'Destroying user directory /data/user/0 because we failed to enforce serial number' (line 16470) and invokes destroyUserDataLI(..., FLAG_STORAGE_CE) -> installd.destroyUserData -> delete_dir_contents_and_dir('/data/data', true). While T661 protected /data/user_de/0 with self-bind mounts, /data/data packages had no self-bind mounts and were wiped.
supply_chain_analysis.zygote_lookup_mechanism: In com_android_internal_os_Zygote.cpp:getAppDataDirName(), Zygote checks stat('/data_mirror/data_ce/null/0/<pkg>'). Because /data/data was wiped or not mirrored in /data_mirror/data_ce/null/0, stat returned ENOENT. Zygote fell back to readdir('/data_mirror/data_ce/null/0') looking for d_ino == ce_data_inode. The directory was absent, so readdir exhausted all entries without finding the inode, triggering fail_fn(CREATE_ERROR('Unable to find...')) and JNI FatalError SIGABRT.

ruled_out_alternatives: SELinux policy denials: Permissive mode confirmed (permissive=1, enforcing=0).
Zygote code bug: Standard AOSP 13 App Data Directory Isolation implementation.
Static packages.xml corruption: Database is generated dynamically during first-boot scan.
Direct Boot decryption failure: Virtual guest uses emulated FBE without hardware Keystore lock on user 0.

fix_strategy.do_prep: Pre-create, provision (UID 10108 for permissioncontroller, 10083 for systemui, 1000 for settings, mode 0700), and self-bind mount packages in /data/data, bind-mount to /data/user/0, and bind-mount to /data_mirror/data_ce/null/0.
fix_strategy.watcher_daemon: Maintain /data_mirror/data_ce/null/0 and /data/user/0; dynamically self-bind mount any package in /data/data/* to protect from deletion (EBUSY on rmdir/unlink) and mirror into /data_mirror/data_ce/null/0 and /data_mirror/data_de/null/0.
fix_strategy.t661_de_preservation: All T661 DE self-bind mounts and mirror mechanisms preserved intact.
